knobs.note: BH-7261: seconds the one weekly brief call may run (bin/agent-call.sh timeout). Read by bin/pm-groom.sh as ${PM_GROOM_TIMEOUT_S:-300}; outside 60..1200 is one warn line in logs/pm-groom.log and the default.
BH-7261: an operator override of the model for this box only. Empty is the product.pm model route (lane_model PM_MODEL product.pm); no route is rc 75 and no call.
BH-7261: test seam, the lane clock in epoch seconds. Read by bin/pm-groom.sh only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1; empty is the clock. A box never sets it.
BH-7261: test seam gate. bin/pm-groom.sh reads PM_GROOM_NOW only when this is 1. A box never sets it.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
